status: Production service deployed and complete domestic HTTPS/durable offline cache verified; catalogue registration owned separately

sourceBinding.identity: Exact unchanged original ID and native problem URL
sourceBinding.statement: Exact approved source Markdown SHA256 and original archive URL present in that text
sourceBinding.resource: Exact ZIP SHA256, bytes, 64 KiB chunk hashes, member inventory and manual review record SHA256
sourceBinding.redirects: Rejected by the existing TLS-verifying service opener

desktopInterface.range: One explicit bytes=start-end or bytes=start- range; invalid/multiple ranges return 416
desktopInterface.requestGates: Existing local Host and account gates; public immutable transfer does not hold personal account-switch barrier
desktopInterface.readingLink: Original source anchor resolves to a native same-origin download through the real Workbench

cache.resume: Recheck the contiguous 64 KiB prefix, discard only an unverified tail, request the remaining range
cache.checksumFailureRetry: No automatic checksum-failure retry; keep verified prefix for explicit retry
cache.completion: Verify all chunks and whole SHA256, fsync, atomic rename; hold the final outgoing block until validation succeeds
cache.offline: Revalidate cached bytes and serve without a source server or Internet connection
cache.accountState: Public input cache is independent of personal account databases

domesticDistribution.source: A staged exact local file; no arbitrary upstream proxy
domesticDistribution.capacity: Four simultaneous transfers, 64 KiB bounded blocks, ten minute transfer timeout
domesticDistribution.checks: Per-block checks before each response; full response checks whole SHA256; unknown hashes, queries, symlinks, missing/truncated bytes refused
domesticDistribution.receiptRequirement: Must contact the approved distribution origin, verify exact full bytes and durable cache, then replay with network disabled; an already-complete cache is refused as an origin test
domesticDistribution.proxy: The updates prefix is stripped, then /required-downloads/* is always forwarded to the reviewed Node index and checked stream, before file_server. Existing cached asset and account routes stay unchanged.

activationBoundary.nativeClarification: The original calls four values positive integers but defines zero-based region and country numbers and supplies zero values; the pending text correctly says four integers and preserves all original constraints and samples.
